image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a single bagel resting on brown parchment paper. The bagel is golden-brown with a glossy crust and is heavily topped with a mixture of seeds (likely sesame and poppy) and coarse salt. A distinct central hole is visible, though partially obscured by the toppings and the angle.
